# Oriana Medi d.o.o.

> JAZMP-registered importer and distributor of medical devices in Slovenia (Rogatec), supplying Slovenian hospitals since 1999. Specialised in devices for vascular interventions (PTCA, PTA, neuroradiology and carotid procedures) and Qlicksmart sharps-safety products. For medical device manufacturers: distribution in Slovenia, public tender services for Slovenian hospital tenders, and a free EUDAMED Readiness Check.

- Company: Oriana Medi d.o.o., Celjska cesta 47, 3252 Rogatec, Slovenia; VAT SI60729635; reg. no. 9944800000
- Contact: info@orianamedi.com
- Languages: Slovenian, Croatian, Serbian, English
